title: Sending limits — per day and month
summary: This document lists current sending limits for Individual ($1,500 daily, $12,500 monthly) and Business accounts ($15,000 daily, $150,000 monthly). It explains how limits trigger decline messages, when partial payments may be submitted, and where to check remaining limits on the send screen.
